INFRARED SAUNA CERAMIC HEATERS

Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

Ceramic heaters have been used in saunas for over 30 years. Find out why and how you can get a quality, top-notch one!

At InfraredSaunaParts, we make sure our customers get only the best equipment they need for their infrared sauna. Many suppliers aren’t able to keep up with the changes of technology and tend to go out of business after 5 years, leaving their clients hanging.

InfraredSaunaParts have been in business for more than 15 years and we continue to supply infrared sauna equipment and accessories to our customers all over the country as well as to some other countries.

“I can’t believe how easy and friendly it is to do business with InfraredSaunaParts. They have everything that I need and I know I’m not going to find another supplier ever again!”

Melissa, Manila, Philippines

Many of our clients chose our ceramic heaters over other brands because we have perfected our method in producing quality heaters. Because many sauna patrons prefer ceramic heaters to carbon heaters due to its tolerable heat hence allowing them to use it for longer period, we make sure that our ceramic heaters strictly follow the safety regulations criteria.

We have ceramic heaters in black or white and you can choose from our other accessories part to complete the heaters in your sauna. We also have EMF true wave ceramic infrared heaters in different capacity so you’re able to find the right one for your sauna.

At InfraredSaunaParts, we also have highly trained personnel that can install your infrared equipment as well as maintain them. We prefer to have professional and long lasting relationship with our clients so it’s our promise to make sure we’re able to cater to your every sauna needs. Even if we don’t have something that you may need, you can let us know and we’ll make sure we can find it for you because we’re constantly updating and restocking our inventory.

Why not call the number today and ask us how we can help you with your infrared sauna business?
